meta.title: 工作量突增是提拔信号还是被当工具人
meta.title_en: More Work: A Promotion Sign or Being Used as a Tool?

scenes.title_cn: 为什么提拔前先加工作
scenes.title_en: Why extra work comes before promotion
scenes.context: 讲者解释管理者提拔前必须安排更多工作的三个原因。
sentences: 如果你的工作在整个团队里面不是最重要或最多的，凭什么提拔你呢？
If your work isn't the most important or the heaviest in the team, why should you be promoted?
凭什么提拔：why should you be promoted
我提拔你是干啥？是来节省我的时间和减少我的精力占用的。
Why would I promote you? To save my time and reduce the energy I have to spend.
节省我的时间：save my time
如果不让你在一些难的事情上历练一下，我怎么知道我提拔人就不会错呢？
If I never put you through hard tasks, how would I know I'm not promoting the wrong person?
历练：put you through hard tasks
paraphrase: 工作量增加=提拔前的必要验证
More work is the necessary test before promotion.
More work isn't a promise — judge the nature of it.
scenes.speak: If your work isn't the most important or the heaviest in the team, why should you be promoted? Why would I promote you? To save my time and reduce the energy I have to spend. If I never put you through hard tasks, how would I know I'm not promoting the wrong person?

scenes.title_cn: 成果导向与让努力可见
scenes.context: 讲者指出「没给我加钱」的想法不该有，回报看结果，且努力要被看见。
sentences: 你的脑海里只要出现「老板给我增加了工作，但是又没给我加钱」这个想法，你就不应该被提拔。
The moment you think "more work but no raise," you've disqualified yourself from promotion.
不应该被提拔：disqualified from promotion
所有的回报我们是以最终的结果来判定的，不是以工作时长来判定的。
Rewards are judged by outcomes, not by hours worked.
以结果判定：judged by outcomes
老板最烦的就是你永远不让大家看到你的努力和你的价值，只是闷头吭哧吭哧地干活。
What bosses hate most is you grinding away silently, never letting anyone see your effort and value.
闷头干活：grinding away silently
paraphrase: The "no raise" mindset disqualifies you first.
回报=结果→工时不是筹码
scenes.speak: The moment you think "more work but no raise," you've disqualified yourself from promotion. Rewards are judged by outcomes, not by hours worked. What bosses hate most is you grinding away silently, never letting anyone see your effort and value.

scenes.title_cn: 工具人 vs 老业务托付
scenes.context: 讲者给出识别工具人的方法，并解释老业务维护可能是例外的提拔信号。
sentences: 你识别完了以后发现，老板安排的那些工作基本没有他自己最关心的战略相关的工作，全都是杂活。
After reviewing them, you find none of the assignments touch his strategic priorities — it's all busywork.
战略相关的工作：strategic priorities
那就是直接把你当工具人用了，那这种情况你还在那混干嘛，赶紧换吧。
That means you're being used as a tool. Why keep hanging around? Switch jobs.
当工具人用：being used as a tool
那些老业务的维护是公司生存的基本，只是在这个阶段没有出彩，是因为有你。
Maintaining legacy business is the company's lifeline — it just doesn't shine right now, precisely because you've got it covered.
生存的基本：the company's lifeline
paraphrase: 工具人的标志→杂活＋被冷落
A tool-man is paid in busywork and ignored.
老业务=底子→托付即信任
Legacy business is the bedrock — being trusted with it is a signal.
scenes.speak: After reviewing them, you find none of the assignments touch his strategic priorities — it's all busywork. That means you're being used as a tool. Why keep hanging around? Switch jobs. Maintaining legacy business is the company's lifeline — it just doesn't shine right now, precisely because you've got it covered.

practice: Judge the nature of the work, not just the volume.
Rewards are judged by outcomes, not by hours worked.
Make sure your effort and value are visible to your boss.
The legacy business is the company's lifeline.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The boss gave me more work but didn't give me money.
✓ 地道说法：More work but no raise — and that mindset disqualifies you.
disqualify 表达「失去被提拔资格」更准确。
✕ 直译腔：Judge by working time, not by result.
✓ 地道说法：Rewards are judged by outcomes, not by hours worked.
outcomes vs hours 对比更清晰。
✕ 直译腔：The boss ignores me when I report.
✓ 地道说法：My updates get brushed off.
get brushed off 表达「被打发、不被重视」。
✕ 直译腔：Legacy business is the bottom of the company.
✓ 地道说法：The legacy business is the company's lifeline.
lifeline 表达「底子、命脉」更贴切。
shifts: 工作量突增只是前提，看工作性质
回报看结果，先出成绩再谈回报
老业务是底子，托付可能是信任
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「不会就退」校正为「不会（选）错（看错人）」，「馒头坑吃坑吃」校正为「闷头吭哧吭哧」，「顺水推舟」保留原意，「不被噤声」校正为「不被重用」，「是将用的问题」校正为「是先任用的问题（人才任用）」，「搞完了在家里别的那」校正为「搞完了放那（别的话）」，「工具人方向」校正为「科研方向/工具方向」，「安生立命」校正为「安身立命」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
